title: Sandbox manifest (contract C5, spec 0.1)
description: The portable description of one sandbox run: what `ovara box` is told, as a file another tool can write, keep in a repository or hand to a service. It names no secret; credentials stay in Ovara's deployment. See spec/runtime.md.

tier.description: 1: separate user, network namespace, own root file system (default). 2: a container.

deployment.description: Ovara's own directory for the run (policy.json, proxy.json, keys); empty means the default.

profile.description: dev: installs are free. strict: a dependency not in the project's lockfiles pauses once, and npm install scripts are off.

untrusted_lockfiles.description: strict: trust nothing the project's lockfiles pin.

mounts.description: Host paths mounted read-only into the box, as SRC:DST. Secret locations are refused by the launcher.

command_gate.description: false runs the agent without the check on every program it starts; the network and file boundaries still hold. Absent means true.

ui.description: The approval page address (loopback only), or "off".

source.description: The project directory on the host (a git repository). The agent works on a copy.

exclude.description: Extra path globs left out of the copy; .ovaraignore is read too.

name.description: The named agent the run is attributed to (its own proxy token).

command.description: The agent's command line, program first.

env.description: Extra variables for the agent. A name that says it is a key, with a value, is refused.

name.description: Tier 1: the network namespace name (one box per name).

user.description: Tier 1: the unprivileged user the agent runs as.

root_fs.description: Tier 1: a root file system of its own (default), or the host's (unsafe on a machine with secrets).

allow_visible_procs.description: Tier 1: start on a kernel that cannot hide other users' processes from the box.

github_scope.description: repo (default): the GitHub key only goes with requests about the project's own repository.

disabled.description: Leave the changes in the workspace; offer nothing.

allow_binary.description: Let binary files the agent added or changed come back.

approve_timeout.description: How long the commit-back waits for a person, as a duration ("10m").

keep_workspace.description: Keep the workspace after the run whatever happened.
